paper_title: Improved limits on the coupling of ultralight bosonic dark matter to photons from optical atomic clock comparisons
coupling_convention: dimensionless d_e (scalar photon coupling), reconstructed via Eq.(8) of the paper from quoted amplitude limits, including the paper's factor-3 stochastic rescaling
notes: Filzinger et al. (PTB) 2023: optical clock comparisons Yb+ E3/E2 (k_alpha=6.95, ~235 days over 26 months) and Yb+ E3/Sr (k_alpha=6.01, ~343 h over 41 days) constraining oscillations of alpha and hence d_e over m_phi ~ 1e-24 to 2e-17 eV. No numeric table given; limits shown only in Fig. 4. Data points reconstructed from text: flat 95% CL amplitude bound A < 2e-17 for E3/E2 (f > 1/T ~ 1.6e-8 Hz), ~3x tighter from E3/Sr above mid-1e-6 Hz, 1/omega^2 amplitude scaling below 1/T, converted via |d_e| = omega*A/k_alpha * sqrt(c^2/(8*pi*G*rho_DM)) with rho_DM = 0.4 GeV/cm^3 and factor-3 stochastic correction. Values are order-of-magnitude reconstructions of the exclusion curve, not digitized from the figure.
